permitted_snippet: Hamas and other Palestinian factions opposed to Fatah are considering forming a broad electoral coalition for the upcoming November elections, while Fatah plans to run independently.

headline: Palestinian Voter Registration Closes Ahead of Legislative Elections
permitted_snippet: The Central Elections Commission announced that voter registration for the 2026 legislative elections will close on August 19, urging unregistered citizens to complete the process.

headline: Palestinian Voter Registration Begins Ahead of 2026 Legislative Elections
permitted_snippet: The Palestinian Central Elections Commission initiated voter registration for the legislative elections scheduled on November 28, 2026. The registration period runs from August 15 to August 19, 2026, at 467 centers across the West Bank and refugee camps.

headline: Palestinian Voter Registration Begins Ahead of 1st Legislative Elections in 20 Years
permitted_snippet: Voter registration and data updates began across the occupied West Bank on Saturday ahead of Palestinian legislative elections scheduled for Nov. 28, the first such vote in nearly 20 years.

headline: Hamas says it will take part in Palestinian elections under broadest possible coalition
permitted_snippet: Hamas has announced its intention to participate in the upcoming Palestinian legislative elections under the broadest possible national coalition. Senior Hamas official Hussam Badran emphasized the group's opposition to imposing political conditions on candidates and described the elections as a 'historic opportunity' to change the Palestinian political landscape.

headline: Hamas Announces Participation in Upcoming Palestinian Legislative Elections Under Broad Coalition
permitted_snippet: Hamas declares its intention to participate in the November 2026 Palestinian legislative elections, aiming to form a broad national coalition and rejecting political conditions for candidates.

headline: President Abbas Issues Decree-Law Amending General Elections Law
permitted_snippet: The Central Elections Commission received a Decree-Law amending the General Elections Law, reinstating the number of Legislative Council members to 132 and introducing provisions for women's representation and a 1% electoral threshold.

headline: Palestinian President Restores Parliament to 132 Seats, Reverses Expansion
permitted_snippet: President Mahmoud Abbas issued a decree restoring the Palestinian Legislative Council's seats to 132, reversing a previous expansion to 200 seats. The new decree retains provisions such as lowering the minimum age for parliamentary candidates from 28 to 23, requiring women to comprise at least 33% of candidates on electoral lists, and maintaining a 1% electoral threshold.

headline: PalThink for Strategic Studies Explores Legislative Elections and the Emergence of New Political Movements
permitted_snippet: PalThink convened discussions on the importance of holding legislative elections as scheduled, focusing on renewing constitutional legitimacy and encouraging new political movements.

headline: President Abbas Confirms Legislative Elections on November 28, 2026
permitted_snippet: President Mahmoud Abbas reaffirms that the Palestinian legislative elections will proceed as scheduled on November 28, 2026, highlighting the importance of these elections for Palestinian democracy.

headline: Palestinian Central Elections Commission Announces Legal Deadlines for 2026 Legislative Elections
permitted_snippet: The Central Elections Commission set the schedule for the 2026 legislative elections, including voter registration from August 15 to August 19, 2026, candidate registration from September 26 to October 7, 2026, and election day on November 28, 2026.

headline: Abbas Sets Nov. 28 for Palestinian Legislative Elections
permitted_snippet: President Mahmoud Abbas issued a decree setting November 28, 2026, as the date for legislative elections, marking the first legislative vote since January 2006. The decree calls on Palestinians in Jerusalem, the West Bank, and Gaza to participate in free and direct legislative elections to choose members of the Palestinian Legislative Council.

headline: Abbas calls the first Palestinian legislative elections since 2006
permitted_snippet: President Mahmoud Abbas has called for the first Palestinian legislative elections since 2006, scheduled for November 28, 2026.

headline: The President Issues a Law Amending the General Elections Law
permitted_snippet: President Mahmoud Abbas issued a law amending the General Elections Law, increasing the number of Legislative Council members to 200 and introducing other electoral reforms.

headline: Fatah Opens Leadership Election to Former Convicts
permitted_snippet: Fatah extends voting rights to former convicts, including those released from life sentences, in its leadership elections.

headline: Hamas congratulates Fatah, urges broad Palestinian dialogue
permitted_snippet: Hamas congratulated Fatah on the conclusion of its eighth congress and called for broad Palestinian dialogue aimed at strengthening national unity. The group expressed hope that the outcomes of the congress would contribute to serving Palestinian interests at a critical stage.

headline: Hamas Calls For Direct Meeting With Fatah Movement To Agree On National Strategy
permitted_snippet: Hamas has called for a direct meeting with Fatah to agree on a joint national strategy following Fatah's eighth general congress. Senior Hamas member Husam Badran stated that the congress represents an opportunity to shift Palestinian internal relations and enhance readiness to confront Israeli plans.

headline: Hamas Seeks Direct Meeting with Fatah to Agree on National Strategy
permitted_snippet: Hamas calls for a direct meeting with Fatah to develop a unified national strategy following Fatah's eighth general conference.

headline: Palestinian President Abbas pledges elections, reform at Fatah conference
permitted_snippet: Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas pledged to hold long-delayed presidential and parliamentary elections during Fatah's eighth general conference. He also committed to implementing reform measures within the Palestinian Authority.

headline: Fatah Claims 'Sweeping Victory' in 2026 Palestinian Local Elections
permitted_snippet: Fatah claimed to have achieved a 'sweeping victory' in the 2026 council elections, winning most local councils, including Jenin, where the Palestinian Authority was previously accused of losing control to Hamas-linked Palestinian Islamic Jihad.

headline: Palestinians Vote in West Bank and Central Gaza Municipal Elections, the First Since War Started
permitted_snippet: Palestinians voted in local elections on Saturday in the Israeli-occupied West Bank and in Gaza. This marked the first vote of any kind held in the Gaza Strip in two decades since Hamas won in 2006.
